codebook_feedback: D2 close call vs D3 examples: the D2 rule says unrequested background after any AI question counts as D2, but the D3 examples (69fff128, 66d9e5be) follow AI turns ending in a conditional request ('If you tell me where the pain is...'); the codebook should say whether such conditional requests count as 'the AI asked'. Short overall durations like 'started hurting yesterday' (69600cc8) or vague 'lately' (63e55f08) are hard to place between background duration and main complaint. In mental-health chats (6a0206ae) the line between main complaint and background is unclear. Fragmentary first messages (6a10664c 'I get this time time') are hard to judge for D1.
